answer:
**Bottom Line**

Exploratory pilot only: in the reportable pilot subset, daily mood was lower during the intern year by about **0.79 points** on the 1-10 scale, compared with before internship (**95% CI -0.88 to -0.69; 22 participants**). Per the approved plan, I stopped before the full run, so this is **not yet the cohort answer**.

The full planned analysis looks feasible and small: **135 enrolled participants** have valid mood data in both periods, with **6,341 pre-internship** and **17,039 intern-year** participant-days. Mood scores were numeric, ranged **1-10**, and duplicate participant-days will be averaged as planned.

plan.question: Did daily mood change from before internship to during the intern year in the 2025 IHS cohort, and by how much?
plan.estimand: Primary estimand: the within-person mean change in daily mood score, defined as each participant's mean mood during the intern-year period minus their mean mood in the pre-internship period, among 2025 participants with at least one valid mood observation in both periods. Secondary descriptive estimand: the difference between all observed daily mood scores in the two periods, with uncertainty accounting for repeated days nested within participants.
plan.exposure: Time period relative to internship start: pre-internship versus intern year. I will operationalize internship start as July 1, 2025 unless a cohort-specific start-date field is available in the approved IHS_2025 metadata; pre-internship will be dates before July 1, 2025 and intern year will be July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, limited to dates available in the 2025 schema.
plan.outcome: Daily mood from IHS_2025.VW_DAILY_MOOD: MOOD_SCORE, dated by MOOD_STARTDATE. I will inspect valid score coding and use numeric mood values only, after documenting range and nonnumeric/missing values.
plan.covariates: No covariate adjustment for the primary question, because the question is a before-versus-during change in the same participants. Participant-level fixed pairing/within-person summaries will address stable between-person differences. I will not interpret this as causal.
plan.cohort: IHS_2025 cohort. Include enrolled participants represented in IHS_2025.VW_DAILY_MOOD with nonmissing participant identifier, valid date, and numeric mood score. Primary analysis includes participants with at least one valid mood day before internship and at least one valid mood day during the intern year. I will report observations, participants observed in each period, and participants contributing within-person change.
plan.decisions: Before modeling I will check duplicates per participant-day, date range, missing/nonnumeric mood scores, score range, impossible values, unmatched or missing identifiers, and period coverage. If multiple mood entries exist for a participant-day, I will average valid numeric scores within that participant-day before period summaries. Primary uncertainty will be a 95% CI for the mean paired participant-level change, using participants as the independent unit. I will also run a sensitivity requiring at least 7 valid mood days in each period and report it as planned sensitivity. Because this is a new empirical question, I will first run a small pilot that exercises the full pipeline, then ask approval before scaling to the full cohort.

queries:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    TRUNC(CAST(m.MOOD_STARTDATE AS DATE)) AS mood_date,
    m.MOOD_SCORE,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
      THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE))
    END AS mood_numeric,
    CASE WHEN s.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS enrolled_flag
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_DAILY_MOOD m
  LEFT JOIN IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY s
    ON m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = s.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
), dup_days AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
  FROM base
  WHERE PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL AND mood_date IS NOT NULL AND mood_numeric IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
), per_period AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN mood_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'pre_internship'
      WHEN mood_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'intern_year'
      ELSE 'outside_window'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participants_any,
    COUNT(mood_numeric) AS rows_numeric_mood,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mood_numeric IS NOT NULL THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS participants_numeric_mood,
    MIN(mood_date) AS min_mood_date,
    MAX(mood_date) AS max_mood_date,
    MIN(mood_numeric) AS min_numeric_mood,
    MAX(mood_numeric) AS max_numeric_mood,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mood_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mood_numeric IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_or_nonnumeric_mood,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN enrolled_flag = 1 THEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER END) AS participants_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY CASE
      WHEN mood_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'pre_internship'
      WHEN mood_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'intern_year'
      ELSE 'outside_window'
    END
)
SELECT period, rows_total, participants_any, rows_numeric_mood, participants_numeric_mood,
       min_mood_date, max_mood_date, min_numeric_mood, max_numeric_mood,
       rows_missing_identifier, rows_missing_date, rows_missing_or_nonnumeric_mood,
       participants_enrolled,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dup_days) AS duplicate_participant_days
FROM per_period
ORDER BY period

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    TRUNC(CAST(m.MOOD_STARTDATE AS DATE)) AS mood_date,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
      THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE))
    END AS mood_numeric
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_DAILY_MOOD m
  JOIN IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY s
    ON m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = s.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
   AND s.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
  WHERE m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
    AND m.MOOD_STARTDATE IS NOT NULL
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
    AND ORA_HASH(m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, 19) = 0
    AND TRUNC(CAST(m.MOOD_STARTDATE AS DATE)) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
), day_level AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date, AVG(mood_numeric) AS mood_score_day, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_day
  FROM base
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date
)
SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date, mood_score_day, rows_in_day,
       CASE WHEN mood_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'pre_internship' ELSE 'intern_year' END AS period
FROM day_level
ORDER BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date

WITH base AS (

  JOIN IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY s

  WHERE m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
    AND m.MOOD_STARTDATE IS NOT NULL
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
    AND ORA_HASH(m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, 4) = 0
    AND TRUNC(CAST(m.MOOD_STARTDATE AS DATE)) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
), day_level AS (

SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date, mood_score_day, rows_in_day,

FROM day_level
ORDER BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
    TRUNC(CAST(m.MOOD_STARTDATE AS DATE)) AS mood_date,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(m.MOOD_SCORE), '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS numeric_flag
  FROM IHS_2025.VW_DAILY_MOOD m
  JOIN IHS_2025.VW_IHS_PARTICIPANT_SUMMARY s
    ON m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER = s.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
   AND s.STUDY_PARTICIPANT_ID IS NOT NULL
  WHERE m.PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
    AND m.MOOD_STARTDATE IS NOT NULL
    AND TRUNC(CAST(m.MOOD_STARTDATE AS DATE)) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
), day_level AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date,
         CASE WHEN mood_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'pre_internship' ELSE 'intern_year' END AS period,
         MAX(numeric_flag) AS has_numeric_mood
  FROM base
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, mood_date,
           CASE WHEN mood_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'pre_internship' ELSE 'intern_year' END
), person_counts AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
         SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'pre_internship' AND has_numeric_mood = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pre_days,
         SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'intern_year' AND has_numeric_mood = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS intern_days
  FROM day_level
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS enrolled_participants_with_any_day,
  SUM(pre_days) AS valid_pre_participant_days,
  SUM(intern_days) AS valid_intern_participant_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pre_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants_with_pre,
  SUM(CASE WHEN intern_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants_with_intern,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pre_days > 0 AND intern_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants_with_both,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pre_days >= 7 AND intern_days >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS participants_with_both_ge7_days
FROM person_counts
